title: Harold Fannin's late TD pushes Browns past Panthers, 21-18

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Harold Fannin's late TD pushes Browns past Panthers, 21-18
sources.description: It took a big drive in the fourth quarter, but the Browns were able to come back and defeat the Panthers to move to 2-1 on the young season.
